name: Star statue
about: A bright yellow star standing on a stone base.

layers.name: Base
layers.tip: A line of stone bricks, 5 long and 3 deep.

layers.name: Feet
layers.tip: Two yellow wool, near each end of the base.

layers.name: Legs
layers.tip: Two wool on each leg, coming in towards the middle.

layers.name: Middle
layers.tip: Three wool in the middle join the legs.

layers.name: Arms
layers.tip: Seven wool, all the way across.

layers.name: Tip
layers.tip: One more on top makes the point.
